verses.t: “Pañcakkhandhā pariññātā, tiṭṭhanti chinnamūlakā; Dukkhakkhayo anuppatto, patto me āsavakkhayo”ti. … Isidatto thero … vaggo dvādasamo.
Jento ca vacchagotto ca, vaccho ca vanasavhayo; Adhimutto mahānāmo, pārāpariyo yasopi ca; Kimilo vajjiputto ca, isidatto mahāyasoti. Ekakanipāto niṭṭhito.
Vīsuttarasataṁ therā, katakiccā anāsavā; Ekakeva nipātamhi, susaṅgītā mahesibhīti.
